_meta.scope: 65 Private Label website pages (HubSpot portal 4087538, site-page drafts)
_meta.note: Every page is NEEDS FIX because the shared Global Footer alone is disqualifying (it names DaVinci Laboratories and carries a TBD placeholder). counts_excluding_sitewide_footer shows each page judged only on its own content.

site_wide_findings.type: no canonical URL set on any page
site_wide_findings.evidence: linkRelCanonicalUrl is empty on all 65 drafts. Combined with the byte-identical duplicate blog page, this is an active duplicate-content risk at launch.
site_wide_findings.fix: Set self-referencing canonicals to the www.praxerasupplements.com URL on every page before publish.

site_wide_findings.type: no featured image on any page
site_wide_findings.evidence: featuredImage and featuredImageAltText are empty on all 65 drafts, so og:image link previews (Slack, LinkedIn, iMessage) will render blank.
site_wide_findings.fix: Set a featured image per page, or at minimum a site-wide default Praxera share card.

site_wide_findings.type: every image on the site is hosted on another brand's domain
site_wide_findings.evidence: All 132 distinct image URLs across the 65 pages resolve to www.pettechlabs.com (61), info.davincilabs.com (37), 4087538.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net (31) or f.hubspotusercontent30.net (3). Zero images are served from a Praxera-owned path. All 132 currently return HTTP 200/206 (verified by ranged GET), so nothing is broken today - but 98 of them depend on the old brand's and a sibling brand's domains staying up.
site_wide_findings.fix: Re-upload all non-portal-CDN assets into the Praxera File Manager and repoint every src before the DaVinci and PetTechLabs domains change.

site_wide_findings.type: page url field still points at the old domain
site_wide_findings.evidence: All 65 drafts have domain = 'www.praxerasupplements.com' but url = 'https://info.davincilabs.com/...'. Expected to recompute at publish, but unverified.
site_wide_findings.fix: Publish one page to a staging slug and confirm the resolved URL is on praxerasupplements.com before bulk-publishing.

site_wide_findings.type: the site footer names DaVinci Laboratories on all 65 pages
site_wide_findings.evidence: Global Footer module caption default: "About Private Label ... Sibling brand to FoodScience Corporation and DaVinci Laboratories." Template Page - DND.html renders it with no overrides and no page overrides it, so it is reader-visible site-wide. This is the single clearest violation of the no-DaVinci rule.
site_wide_findings.fix: Edit /Private Label/Modules/Global Footer caption. One edit clears all 65 pages.

site_wide_findings.type: the site footer still says "Operational address TBD / Awaiting brand lock"
site_wide_findings.evidence: Global Footer address default renders that text in the footer of all 65 pages, while the body copy elsewhere already publishes 929 Harvest Lane, Williston, VT 05495.
site_wide_findings.fix: Fill in the confirmed address in the Global Footer module.

site_wide_findings.type: prohibited manufacturer claim lives in two shared global blocks
site_wide_findings.evidence: PL - Global Heritage (id 218944099156, embedded by 42 pages) stores "we are one of the most trusted dietary supplement manufacturers" and "Every private label supplement we produce...", with eyebrow "50+ YEARS OF SUPPLEMENT MANUFACTURING". PL - Global Guide Offer (id 218944099153, embedded by 45 pages) stores "build your brand with our manufacturing team". Neither string appears in the page JSON, so a page-content-only audit misses them.

site_wide_findings.fix: Do not change any slug. Refresh reference/page_index.json from the live drafts, and re-check any redirect map or internal-link rewrite that was generated from the stale list - it would point at the un-prefixed paths.
